name: Fireworks AI serverless inference
price_basis: USD per 1M TOKENS, representative model accounts/fireworks/models/gpt-oss-120b Standard tier, observed 2026-10-14 ($0.15 input / $0.015 cached input / $0.60 output). Fireworks prices THREE modes: Standard, Priority (+25% on every cell), and Fast (a separate, higher-priced serving path - Kimi K3 Fast is $4.50/$22.50 vs Standard $3.00/$15.00). Unlisted models fall back to size brackets: <4B $0.10, 4-16B $0.20, >16B $0.90, MoE <=56B $0.50, MoE 56.1-176B $1.20 (one number for input+output). Batch inference = 50% of serverless. '(US)' region-pinned variants of the headline models cost 1.5x the global price.
notes: No measured_ttft/tps recorded: Fireworks does not publish per-model speed on the pricing page and this pass did not land a third-party median for this provider - Artificial Analysis benchmarks Fireworks on Llama 3.3 70B but the live cells were not extractable today, so the fields stay null rather than carrying a second-hand number. 'Fast' serverless mode is the paid-latency tier; Standard is the default the basis prices. Fireworks also sells on-demand GPU deployments ($/hr) which are supply-type records, not this one.
